text:
kevin: Hey folks — PR 13450 is stuck behind CI failures only on pool4 (linux-gpu-4). integration/storage/kv-timeout flakes ~30% on that shard but passes everywhere else. Reference: https://github.com/redwood-inference/pull/13450 :confused:
jen: Ugh, that test again. Is it time-dependent or does it correlate with larger batches? Any recent infra changes on pool4? :eyes:
kevin: Not that I know of. Batches are normal. I ran the failing command locally with the same seed and couldn't repro. Error excerpt from CI:
```
ERROR: integration/storage/kv-timeout failed after 120s
Trace: Timeout waiting for KV service to respond for shard 4
```
ci-bot: CI report for PR 13450 — pool4: FAILED (integration/storage/kv-timeout), other pools: PASSED. Targeted rerun available. (build #7890 queued)
maria: Can we do a targeted rerun for just that shard and, if it fails again, collect a full debug capture? I can enable verbose logging for pool4 for one run. :+1:
alex: Also consider a canary rerun pinned to an earlier commit to bisect whether recent infra change caused it. If rerun passes, we can try a snapshot update if test is legitimately flaky but expected output changed.
jen: I think we should avoid snapshot updates unless test output actually changed. For now: kevin, can you queue a targeted rerun with verbose logs? Include `--collect-trace` so we get tracer output if it times out.
kevin: Queued targeted rerun via ci-bot: `./ci/rerun --pr 13450 --shard pool4 --verbose --collect-trace` — build #7890 kicked. cc @maria for verbose logs.
ci-bot: Targeted build #7890 started on pool4. Attach logs at https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/7890 once finished.
maria: If #7890 fails again, I'll grab the trace and look for slow KV heartbeats or connection resets. If we find a KV regression, we may need a hotfix branch.
jen: FYI if we need approval to bypass merge hold (for urgent fix), ping me and @alex — but let's wait for the rerun first. :handshake:
kevin: Thanks. I'll post results here when #7890 completes. If it flakes again, I'll attach the trace and request a focused rollback test.
jen: perfect — appreciate the async checks.
kevin: (adds) Also adding the PR to the merge hold until we either get two green pool4 runs or we have a clear infra culprit. :lock:
alex: Sounds good. If anyone wants to try a quick local repro, the failing test is `tests/integration/test_kv_timeout.py::test_kv_timeout` with env `KV_TIMEOUT=120` and shard label `pool4`.
ci-bot: Build #7890 finished: pool4 — FAILED (integration/storage/kv-timeout). Logs: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/7890/logs. Artifacts: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/7890/artifacts/trace.zip
kevin: Uploading trace.zip now. Will analyze and follow up with a short triage note and next steps (rerun vs rollback).
maria: On it — will look through the trace and post findings in the morning. If it's a KV saturation issue we can consider temporary throttling on pool4 while we investigate. :mag:
jen: Thanks everyone. If you need merge bypass after triage, @ me directly. :thumbsup:
